steps.prompt: The puck is on the far wall and their LD sneaks toward the middle. Where are you?

options.text: Inside him in the high slot, seeing him and the puck, stick in the cross-ice lane
options.fb: That's the weak-side job. From inside him you see both, so a pass across or to the point gives you a short step, not a race.

options.text: Right on him at the point, a stick length off
options.fb: You have your man, but you've left the slot. With your back to the puck you can't see a pass to the back door, and the high slot is empty for their C.

options.text: Middle of the slot, toward the puck side, to help
options.fb: Puck-watching. He gets behind your shoulder and out of sight. On the D-to-D pass he has a free shot, and the step you took toward the puck is the step you owe back.

options.text: Low, by the far post, in case the puck comes out front
options.fb: That's our D's ice. You've given up the whole top of your side, so any pass to their LD is a free shot from the point.

steps.prompt: D-to-D is coming to your point. Step out now, or hold the slot?

options.text: Step out now, on the pass
options.fb: Right. The puck takes half a second D-to-D, and that's the time it takes to get into his shot lane. You arrive as he catches it, two meters off, and the shot has to come through you.

options.text: Hold until he catches it, then close
options.fb: Right movement, half a second late. He catches it with time to look, and shoots through the lane you are still skating into.

options.text: Hold the slot and block the shot from there
options.fb: From the slot you are six meters off him. He shoots through an open lane, or walks in and shoots from closer.

options.text: Turn back to the puck in case it comes back across
options.fb: Your back is to your man. He gets a free shot from your point, and you find out from the sound of it.

steps.prompt: The D-to-D pass is in the air. Tap where you should be.

fb.right: Out of the slot, on your way into his shot lane. You get there as the puck does.
fb.close: Moving the right way, but a stride short of his lane. He'll have a look at the net before you arrive.
fb.wrong: Still in the middle, or near the puck side. He catches it with nobody in his lane and shoots free.
